summary: Severe snowstorm on the E4 near Örnsköldsvik forces the driver to stop, causing a delay beyond 60 minutes.

timeline.text: Heavy snow on the E4 near Örnsköldsvik, road closed. I'm on the shoulder and have been waiting 45 min. Need to know what to do.

solution.text: Confirm the driver is safe and warm. Get the exact GPS location and a photo of the road closure sign. Inform the driver that waiting time is compensated at EUR 15 per started hour and will be processed after the job. Ask the driver whether they need overnight accommodation because the delay is expected to exceed two hours. If a hotel is required, request a person to approve the hotel cost (must be under the EUR 80 expense limit). Log the waiting compensation automatically. [approval] Hotel booking cost (if any). [person only] Notify the driver once the approval is received and give instructions for check‑in.

facts.fact: Snow warning issued for the E4 corridor, visibility below 100 m.
Driver reports the vehicle stopped on the hard shoulder due to unsafe road conditions.
Policy: waiting at a site beyond 60 minutes is paid EUR 15 per started hour, approved by a person.

simulated.driver: You are on the E4 near Örnsköldsvik, Sweden. Snow is falling heavily, visibility is near zero and the road has been officially closed. Your vehicle is safe on the hard shoulder, you are wearing a high‑visibility vest and have warm clothing. You have been waiting for 45 minutes and have a phone, but no hotel reservation yet.

must: ask whether the driver is safe before anything else
obtain the exact GPS location and a photo of the road‑closure sign
inform the driver about the EUR 15 per hour waiting compensation
ask the driver if accommodation is needed
request a person to approve any hotel cost
must_not: tell the driver to continue driving in unsafe conditions

Current bus (ID 745) is delayed 20 min; expected arrival Hamburg Hauptbahnhof 13:40 local time.

simulated.driver: You are on the delayed bus, seated near the front. The ticket allows you to travel on any bus that day without extra cost.

must: verify bus schedule
confirm arrival within pickup slot
no extra cost

summary: The driver delivered the car late and missed the scheduled ferry home, requiring a hotel stay and the next ferry.

solution.text: Approve a hotel stay up to EUR 100 for tonight (e.g., Hotel Baltic). Record the receipt and schedule the driver on the 07:30 ferry tomorrow. Note the expense for reimbursement and inform the driver to keep all documentation.

facts.fact: The driver completed delivery at Gdańsk Port at 22:10 local time, 45 min after the 21:25 ferry departure scheduled for the driver’s return home.
Company policy: accommodation expenses up to EUR 100 per night are reimbursable with receipt and require manager approval.

schedule next ferry departure
record receipt for reimbursement

summary: The assigned driver reports a scheduling conflict with another job and cannot take the pickup tomorrow.

summary: No ferry slot is available for the planned crossing from Rostock to Gedser at the requested time, risking delay.

update delivery window within allowed shift
record new ferry ticket receipt
